title: Break the documentation alignment final-reassessment deadlock
rawUserRequest: When a process issue blocks governed work, first create a corrective Work Item and do not use a temporary workaround. The documentation-alignment quality gate now requires a final Japanese reassessment bound to changed source, but the documented reassessment occurs after merge; correct the deadlock while preserving fail-closed Japanese evidence. The quality Work Item's current blocked alignment report is continuation evidence only, never final release evidence.

rawRequestSource.reference: RayIori user authorization: process problems require corrective Work Items; no temporary workaround; tracking issue: https://github.com/spirex-ds-dev/ai-cockpit-template/issues/623

declaredIntent.summary: Separate ordinary Work Item finish from final release reassessment while retaining exact-source, fail-closed release evidence.

outOfScope: Changing the Japanese assessment findings, report bytes, evidence-source binding algorithm, or final_reassessment role to make a stale assessment pass.
Weakening release preflight or release-readiness gates, publishing a release, or modifying provider state.
Temporary SKIP_QUALITY, manual report edits, or any bypass that lets a Work Item claim the final reassessment was performed.

acceptance: A Work Item that changes Japanese-assessment-bound source files can complete ordinary documentation metadata/quality and ai-finish lifecycle without generating or misrepresenting a final reassessment.
Release-only preflight/readiness targets continue to require a current final_reassessment and fail closed when its bound source drifts.
The Make/check catalog and workflow documentation distinguish ordinary Work Item verification from release-source-bound final reassessment.
Focused regression tests prove both the ordinary continuation path and the release fail-closed path.
guidelines: Preserve evidence over self-declaration: a stale final assessment must never be accepted as current.
Keep release-only controls explicit and fail closed; do not downgrade them to advisory checks.
Use registered Make check IDs rather than introducing ad-hoc shell commands.
Document lifecycle boundaries in terms consistent with the glossary.

intent.problem: ai-finish injects sourceBoundEvidence for every Work Item. That target requires a final Japanese reassessment whose exact evidence bytes must equal HEAD. A documentation or Make/test corrective changes those bound bytes, while the documented final reassessment must happen only after its PR is merged; ordinary quality/finish therefore cannot complete to reach the merge that permits the reassessment.
constraints: Do not fabricate, rewrite, or relabel final Japanese assessment evidence.
Keep strict source-bound final reassessment in release preflight/readiness.
Do not use temporary quality skips or manual evidence patches.
Preserve active Outcome/blocked continuation evidence produced by the lifecycle engine.
intent.rationale: The final reassessment is release evidence, not a universal pre-merge prerequisite. Separating that release control from ordinary Work Item completion lets the corrective lifecycle produce honest continuation evidence, while publication remains fail closed until a new exact-source final reassessment succeeds.
